provenance.description: Geometry-only extracts of actual .NET WebAssembly runtime captures. Tile rows are lossless compact storage; no party, inventory, journal, actor or image data retained.
provenance.assemblyMetadata: Authored group fields restored by stable runtime prop ID from actual published WASM worlds. Battle groupX/groupY use the same room-origin subtraction as World.BuildArena; geometry and existing state are unchanged.
